SQL:
SELECT
  customers.region_id AS "orders.customers.region_id",
  customers.id AS "orders.customers.id",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
WHERE
  orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
  AND customers__regions.name IS NULL
GROUP BY
  customers.region_id,
  customers.id
LIMIT 21

args.message: Q1 2025 revenue (sum of order amounts, 1 Jan–31 Mar 2025, all order statuses) by customer region: South 10,009.61 (145 orders), North 8,433.41 (136), East 6,593.26 (106), West 3,770.98 (62). Each order was matched to its customer's region with a left join, so orders without a region were kept. I looked for orders whose customer has no known region and found none in this quarter, so there is no unknown-region (null) group.
